why: Excludes 43 of 200 virtual patients (22%), 19 of them for this rule alone; 4 in 10 comparable second-line trials later widened their kidney cutoff.
what_to_do: Consider creatinine clearance >= 45 mL/min, as used by NCT99990012; docetaxel is cleared mainly by the liver.

where: Inclusion I7: ECOG performance status of 0 or 1
why: Excludes 41 of 200 virtual patients (21%), 8 of them for this rule alone; about 1 in 5 second-line patients has ECOG 2.
what_to_do: Consider allowing ECOG 2, possibly as a separately reported subgroup, as NCT99990027 did.

where: Exclusion E1: untreated or symptomatic central nervous system metastases
why: Excludes 25 of 200 virtual patients (12.5%), 7 of them for this rule alone.
what_to_do: Consider allowing small (< 1 cm) asymptomatic untreated brain metastases that need no steroids, as NCT99990033 did.
